meta.name: pua-en
meta.description: Put your AI on a Performance Improvement Plan. Forces exhaustive problem-solving with Western big-tech performance culture rhetoric and structured debugging. Trigger when: (1) task failed 2+ times or stuck tweaking same approach; (2) about to say 'I cannot', suggest manual work, or blame environment without verifying; (3) being passive—not searching, not reading source, just waiting; (4) user frustration: 'try harder', 'stop giving up', 'figure it out', 'again???', or similar. Also for complex debugging, env issues, config/deployment failures. All task types: code, config, research, writing, deployment, infra, API. Do NOT trigger on first-attempt failures or when a known fix is executing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大厂绩效文化话术强制AI深度排查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果AI反复失败或消极等待，需要强制它穷尽排查。
copy.tagline_en: Force AI to exhaustively debug using big-tech performance culture rhetoric.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI keeps failing passively and needs a structured push to solve problems.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会强制自己穷尽所有方法解决问题，不轻易放弃。它会主动搜索、阅读源码、验证假设，并在每次任务后自我检查是否做到位。
howto.when: 当任务失败2次以上、Claude 想放弃或推卸责任、用户表现出不耐烦（如说“再试试”）时触发。也用于复杂调试、环境问题等。

say.text: 这个bug我试了两次还没解决，帮我用PIP模式再试一次。
say.note: 触发L1警告，Claude会切换全新方案。

say.text: 别放弃，再想想其他办法。
say.note: 触发主动搜索和假设验证。

howto.what_en: Forces Claude to exhaust all options before giving up, proactively search, read source, verify assumptions, and self-check after each task.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task fails 2+ times, Claude is about to give up or blame environment, or user shows frustration (e.g., 'try harder'). Also for complex debugging and config failures.

say_en.text: I've failed twice on this bug, use PIP mode to try again.
say_en.note: Triggers L1 warning, Claude switches to a fundamentally different approach.

say_en.text: Don't give up, think of other ways.
say_en.note: Triggers proactive search and hypothesis verification.
